payload.summary: UI polish pass complete: all six of Jim edits asks shipped as five PRs (#2 rail-gutter, #3 tray-rhythm, #4 card-face-declutter, #5 hand-total-placement, #6 double-wager-button), each Codex-reviewed and merged only on APPROVE. Three of the five needed a second round after Codex found real defects: a CSS guard that would not have caught its own regression, a restack breakpoint that guessed the wrong width, and an aria-hidden face that left screen-reader users without the suit. Two defects were found that Jim had not reported and were fixed in passing: the action cluster overflowed its grid track and hid Clear under a chip at every width, and the card centre pip was never centred. One pre-existing bug was filed rather than smuggled in: felt-column-overflow (0fh40zqc), the bet row min-content clipping the felt between 860 and 1240px. Suite grew 69 -> 80 tests, 3484 -> 3538 asserts; tsc clean throughout.
